hero.title: Elections Process
hero.subtitle: Legitimacy of Representation and Student Will
hero.description: The electoral process within the Engineering Association serves as the fundamental pillar of democratic representation and student legitimacy. Through direct and free voting, students across all departments and batches elect their representatives for the Thirty Council and Executive Committee to lead union, academic, and service initiatives.

whyItMatters.title: Protecting Student Rights
whyItMatters.text: Elections ensure the selection of dedicated representatives capable of negotiating with administration to safeguard students' academic and service rights.

whyItMatters.title: Expressing Free Will
whyItMatters.text: Provides every male and female student an equal opportunity to shape the association's vision and select competent candidates.

whyItMatters.title: Accountability & Transparency
whyItMatters.text: Fosters a culture of transparency where each council presents clear financial and operational reports to the General Assembly.

whyItMatters.title: Institutional Continuity
whyItMatters.text: Guarantees smooth and democratic transitions of leadership, maintaining stable and continuous development across successive batches.

processSteps.title: Electoral Committee Setup
processSteps.description: The General Assembly appoints an independent, neutral elections committee to oversee regulations, procedures, and integrity.

processSteps.title: Nominations & Appeals
processSteps.description: Nominations for the 30 Council seats open under established guidelines, followed by a review and appeal window.

processSteps.title: Campaigns & Debates
processSteps.description: Candidates and lists present their action plans, reform visions, and electoral programs through open student forums and debates.

processSteps.title: Direct Voting & Counting
processSteps.description: Students cast their votes through direct ballot boxes or secure online voting. Votes are counted transparently in the presence of candidate agents.

processSteps.title: Results & Council Formation
processSteps.description: The independent committee announces official results. The newly elected council convenes to form the Executive Committee and begin the new term.
